_comment_testRunner: The tap runner executes each test file directly (node <file>), which keeps it in the same process as Stryker coverage hook. Running them via `node --test` forks a child per file, the hook records nothing, and every mutant reports NoCoverage.
_comment_mutate: Only code that tests/unit can meaningfully kill. tests/repo reads the real source tree, which a mutation sandbox deliberately alters, so it is not part of the runner. The Unicode tables are generated data, checked against their sources, not code to mutate.
_comment_incremental: Incremental mode is off: a full run takes about half a minute with per-test analysis, so the complexity and the risk of a stale incremental report are not worth it.
_comment_thresholds: break sits a couple of points below the measured score (100 at the last full run), so an ordinary change cannot fail on noise while a real drop in test strength does.
_comment_tap: The fast-check settings file pins the seed and the case count for a campaign only, so every mutant meets the same inputs; everywhere else the properties run on fast-check's defaults. See tests/unit/fast-check-mutation.cjs.
